title: Yellowed Flaky Venezuelan Chicken Empanadas
description: A resinous and flaky solo dinner dish from Venezuela featuring sherry vinegar and ferment kimchi, made to be low carb friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together almond flour, salt, and black pepper.
Add coconut oil and egg to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and pliable.
Divide the dough into 4 equal pieces and roll each into a ball.
Roll out each ball into a thin circle.
In a separate bowl, mix together chopped chicken breast, sherry vinegar, and ferment kimchi.
Place a quarter of the chicken mixture onto the center of each dough circle.
Fold the dough in half and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with coconut oil and bake for 25 minutes.
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
